title: methodNames
responsibility: Names the methods a service contract declares under a class and puts them in create, read, update, delete order.

inputs.name: within.name
inputs.description: The dotted declaration name being checked against owner. It matches only when it starts with the literal `${owner}.` prefix, or exactly equals owner when whole is true; the value is not normalized.

inputs.name: within.owner
inputs.description: The literal string whose `${owner}.` prefix is checked against name. It is compared as provided, without normalization.

inputs.name: within.whole
inputs.description: Whether an exact name-equals-owner match also counts. It does not change the `${owner}.` prefix match.

inputs.name: methodsNamed.names
inputs.description: The dotted declarations to inspect for methods of owner. Only names starting with the literal `${owner}.` and containing a nonempty method segment are considered; a declaration ending at owner.method is included only when whole is true, and repeated declarations can repeat results.

inputs.name: methodsNamed.owner
inputs.description: The class-name prefix used to identify declaration members. Matching uses the literal `${owner}.` prefix, without normalization.

inputs.name: methodsNamed.whole
inputs.description: Whether a declaration shaped as owner.method is included with no suffix after its method segment. When false, only declarations with a nonempty remaining suffix are included.

inputs.name: orderedMethods.methods
inputs.description: The method names to deduplicate and sort. The first occurrence of each name is kept; priorities are create, then read/find/findBy, update, delete, constructor, and then unlisted names, with equal-priority items retaining first-occurrence order.

outputs.name: within
outputs.description: Whether name.startsWith(`${owner}.`) is true, or whole is true and name exactly equals owner.

outputs.name: methodsNamed
outputs.description: Method segments extracted from declarations starting with the literal `${owner}.` prefix and containing a nonempty method segment, in declaration order. Declarations ending at owner.method are included only when whole is true; duplicates remain.

outputs.name: orderedMethods
outputs.description: Unique input method names sorted by priority: create; read, find, and findBy; update; delete; constructor; then unlisted methods. Names within a priority retain their first-occurrence order.
